creator: Claude Code (claude-sonnet-5-5) worker session tien-nghich-2d-28, 2026-11-22
method: create_character_pro_flash (32x32 native, low top-down, template custom, 8 views, 40-colour palette, seed 11) then animate_character v3 per direction (frames stored at 40 px, centred on the 32 px manifest canvas, no scaling). v3 needs >=4 frames, so the 3-frame idle and telegraph clips use frame_select of 4 generated frames. Four facings are separate generations; nothing mirrored.
prompt: Seam stalker, a small chibi stone-quarry predator that lurks in rock cracks: a flat low slate-grey body with a big head, two glowing pale cyan slit eyes, a jagged glowing cyan crack line running down its back like a seam, four short stubby clawed legs, small stone-plate armour on the shoulders, one bronze claw tip. Crouched stalking pose. Front-facing 3/4 top-down, chunky pixel art, 1px dark outline, light from top-left.

direction_prompts.west: seen from the left side, crouched and breathing slowly, the cyan seam pulses, head sways slightly
direction_prompts.north: seen from behind, crouched and breathing slowly, the cyan seam on its back pulses
direction_prompts.east: seen from the right side, crouched and breathing slowly, the cyan seam pulses, head sways slightly
